title: Grenfell fire police investigators hand files on 20 firms and 54 people to CPS
description:
Met calls move ‘milestone’ moment that paves way for ‘very best possible evidence for charging decisions’

Police investigating the Grenfell Tower fire have asked prosecutors to consider charges including manslaughter and fraud against a range of companies and individuals.

The Metropolitan police announced it had given prosecutors evidence relating to 20 companies and organisations and 54 individuals, ahead of charging decisions, in what the force described as a “milestone moment”.
